files.description: Host kernel patch registry. Every deployable patch under linux-X.Y/ must have a row in the matching Kernel-X.Y section, or deploy_kernel_patches.py silently skips it.
BMC kernel patch registry, same format. Its Legend section at the bottom is the authoritative definition of every legal status value and of the os[]/take[]/skip[] modifiers.

The consumer of both status tables. Defines what the status column actually means: see class CONST for PATCH_OS_SUBFOLDERS and the take/skip/os token names, and parse_status for how modifiers are tokenized.
